description:
A nomad fighter from the camp beyond Phlan, prepared for travel and combat in the open. This is the script-linked icon for MON7CHA.DAX:40. Source inventory: Arrows, Long bow, Short sword, Shield, Leather armor. Readied: Arrows, Short sword, Shield, Leather armor. Source wealth: 15 cp.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT READY:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: OpenGold combat sprite CPIC7.DAX:12/item_002__item_003/ready, exactly one transparent pixel-art frame.
Input image 1 is the approved NEW art currently saved as this variant's ready.png. It is the same Nomad's identity and exact combat-canvas reference; no original game art is attached. The user has selected that source image to become the ACTION frame unchanged. Edit a NEW READY frame from it.
This is a normal 5-foot Nomad fighter facing screen right in front three-quarter view, with blue headband and scarf, tan leather armor, a short sword in his sword hand and the same wood-and-metal shield in his offhand. Keep the head, face, torso, clothing, palette, shield, body height, camera, canvas origin, and BOTH planted foot positions registered to input image 1. Keep the shield protecting the front of the chest.
Change the sword-arm guard so the SHORT SWORD is unmistakably held UP beside/above his right shoulder, blade angled steeply upward and ready to strike. Show one continuous hand-to-hilt-to-full-length blade, with a clear shoulder-elbow-wrist connection. The sword must not point forward/down as a completed thrust. The raised sword may enter the square above the 1x1 body footprint but all visible pixels must remain inside the 128x128 PNG canvas with transparent margin. Keep the one-handed grip and the shield separate. Do not shrink, recenter or translate the figure; do not invent a second weapon, bow, arrow, gear, extra arm, or duplicate character. Exactly one character, one ready frame, no diptych/sheet, no background, ground, shadows, borders, labels, or cropped pixels. Crisp readable pixel art with genuine alpha.

ACTION INSTALL DECISION: For item_002__item_003, copy the previously accepted ready.png to action.png byte-for-byte as requested by the user. Its forward short-sword thrust is the action pose. Preserve the bow set unchanged.
